hero.name: Jere M.
hero.title: Software engineer transitioning into game development

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer with a background in mechanical and ICT engineering. I hold degrees in Mechanical Engineering (2013–2016) and ICT Engineering (2019–2022).

I spent four years at Etteplan working on structural and mechanical design for paper machine components. For the past five years I have focused on mobile development at Alma Media in the Iltalehti application team.

Although my career has centered on mobile products, my primary interest is creating interactive experiences that combine atmosphere, systems, and design. Game development allows me to merge technical problem solving with creative expression.

list.title: IL-Palat
list.summary: I created the initial concept and built a short-form content system for Iltalehti. The project began as a personal prototype and later became a production feature on iOS and Android. It received recognition at the INMA Global Media Awards with placements in Best New Digital Product and Best Innovation in Newsroom Transformation.

list.title: IL Paras Sää Mobile Application
list.summary: I led development and designed the application architecture. I implemented most of the core features and coordinated development work and integration with design and backend teams.

list.title: Telkku Mobile Application
list.summary: A follow-up project to IL Paras Sää. I led development and system architecture under a tight schedule, ensuring consistent performance and maintainable feature development across platforms.

list.title: Horror-Survival Prototype
list.summary: A personal first-person horror project built in Unity with a focus on atmosphere, procedural systems, and systemic gameplay. The project explores environmental storytelling, tension, and scalable game architecture.

list.title: Unity Terrain Feature Painter Tool
list.summary: A Unity Editor tool that automates terrain decoration based on height, slope, texture, and biome rules. Built to speed up level design workflows and ensure consistent placement of environmental elements.

list.title: Character Modeling Workflow
list.summary: A full character asset workflow covering sculpting, retopology, UVs, and texturing for real-time rendering. The goal was to learn each stage required to create clean and optimized game-ready characters.

list.title: Bunker Hard Surface Modeling
list.summary: A modular bunker environment piece focusing on hard surface modeling, clean topology, and a PBR texturing workflow. Built from blockout to final asset in Blender and Substance Painter.

list.title: RIB Boat Model
list.summary: A realistic rigid inflatable boat model with attention to clean shapes, accurate detail, and believable materials. Demonstrates both modeling fundamentals and advanced PBR texturing.

list.title: Pier Environment Asset
list.summary: A modular pier structure designed for real-time environments. Built with reusable parts and proper edge flow, with performance considerations such as LODs.

list.title: Game Props Flashlight and Scanner
list.summary: Game-ready props created for the horror prototype. Focused on functional shapes, readable silhouettes, and accurate PBR materials suited for low-light conditions.

list.title: RepRap 3D Printer Build
list.summary: A custom RepRap-style 3D printer built from individual components. The work combined mechanical design, electronics, and firmware setup using Arduino, RAMPS 1.4, and Marlin. The final printer was fully functional and capable of printing replacement parts.

motivation.title: Motivation
paragraphs: I want to join Aalto's Game Design and Development programme because it aligns with my strengths in engineering and creative problem solving. My background gives me a strong foundation ...
